subject.title: Feature: Inject post-install/update system event into active session

question: Should ClawHub add a consented active-session handoff after skill install/update, or should setup remain an explicit copy-prompt/manual SKILL.md flow?
rationale: The requested behavior changes the trust boundary for publisher-controlled skill instructions and revises an approved spec that currently excludes direct OpenClaw handoff, so automation cannot choose the product/security contract safely.

options.title: Approve consented handoff
options.body: Define a session-targeted, user-approved system event contract with tests and docs before implementing install/update injection.

options.title: Keep copy-prompt-only
options.body: Close or narrow this request after documenting the current explicit prompt flow as the supported setup path for SKILL.md onboarding.

options.title: Align with hook registration first
options.body: Defer this until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2295 settles hook discovery, consent, scanner disclosure, and gateway handoff.

recommendation.title: Approve consented handoff
recommendation.body: Define a session-targeted, user-approved system event contract with tests and docs before implementing install/update injection.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest combined signal from the collaborator prioritization comment and current CLI/install-surface history.
